newsitem.title: USA: Hemasure names John Mcguire CEO.
newsitem.headline: Hemasure names John Mcguire CEO.

text.p: HemaSure Inc said Tuesday it has named John McGuire as president, chief executive officer and a director.
McGuire, 50, is former vice president and general manager of Johnson & Johnson's JNJ.N ortho-diagnostic systems' blood bank business unit. He joined Johnson & Johnson in 1988.
He was also connected with DuPont Co from 1977 to 1988, where he held various management positions, the last of which was national sales manager, AIDs & Hepatitis Business.
HemaSure develops and delivers separations and pathogen inactivation technologies to insure safety for processing blood components and plasma pharmaceuticals worldwide.
